text:
Aisha: Heads up — Helix Therapeutics asked for a condensed enablement plan focused on Dedicated migration + cost ops. They want 3 short drop-ins next week (AM EMEA / APAC / AM Americas). Who can lead docs + a live demo?
Tom: I can run the runtime + demo. EMEA slot works best for me (Tue/Wed morning CET).
Priya: I’ll own the onboarding checklist and post-migration runbook. APAC-friendly time OK for me (Thu 09:30 SGT).
Marta: I can cover billing/commits and renewal signals. Prefer an AM PST slot. I’ll pull a renewal-risk playbook slide.
Aisha: Proposed schedule: Tue 09:30 CET (Tom), Thu 09:30 SGT (Priya), Fri 10:00 PST (Marta). Keep sessions 40m: 25m content, 10m Q, 5m next steps. Sound good?
Tom: Works. Can we add a one-page pre-read with model-variant + quantization recommendations? Saves live time.
Priya: I’ll draft the pre-read and a short checklist. Draft link (in progress): https://docs.redwood.ai/enablements/helix-pre-read
Marta: Adding renewal-risk signals slide — will include churn indicators and recommended mitigation steps.
Aisha: @calendar-bot please create RSVP and a timezone matrix. Invite Helix contacts privately + internal hosts.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Helix Compact Enablement — 3 sessions". RSVP form: https://cal.redwood.ai/r/helix-enable. Hosts: Aisha, Tom, Priya, Marta.
Priya: Quick preference poll: React :rocket: for live demo, :film_projector: for recorded demo.
Tom: I’ll go live for the runtime demo; if we hit noisy KV cache, fallback to the recorded clip.
Aisha: Action items: Priya — pre-read by Mon EOD; Marta — renewal slide by Tue noon; Tom — run-through Wed (EMEA). I’ll confirm Helix attendee list by Mon. :white_check_mark:
